tagline: One row per server. Fewer background probes.
subtitle: The Library lists each MCP server once with its places, lets you take one out, and the app asks plan limits far less often.

cards.title: One row per MCP server
cards.text: A server set up the same in several places is one row, with its places in a Places tab.

cards.title: Take it out of places
cards.text: Remove an MCP server or a skill from one place, all projects or everywhere.

cards.title: Lighter on the battery
cards.text: Plan limits are asked of the programs at most every 15 minutes: 4 launches in 6 minutes instead of 10.

also: Errors show as toasts, not a strip
A hidden window asks for no plan limits
The limits probe starts no MCP servers
